correctness.rationale: The nilpotent rank-one shear has an explicitly invertible form. Its inverse norm reduces exactly to a two-dimensional ℓp shear norm; norm attainment would force a chosen James functional to attain its norm. Every compact perturbation is I plus compact after recentering, giving an exact envelope of 1, attained by cancelling the shear.

originality.rationale: Qualified to the best of our knowledge. Han's 2026 direct-sum CPPm theorem requires distinct exponents p<q, while Raposo--Ribeiro's later diagonal theorem treats only a scalar ℓ∞ summand. Searches found no all-p diagonal version with arbitrary nonzero summand, exact compact envelope, and unbounded defect ratio.

value.rationale: The result fills the diagonal finite-p direct-sum gap, unifies known ℓ1- and ℓ∞-type failures with one rank-one mechanism, and quantifies CPPm failure exactly with arbitrarily large perturbative amplification.

disclaimer: Not independent validation, peer review, or a guarantee of first discovery.
